title: Beautiful Victorian in heart of 5 points/downtown
description:
Welcome to my beautiful and spacious 3 BR, 2.5 BA Victorian home located in Music City's most desirable location:  5 Points in historic East Nashville. Shops, restaurants and social gathering places just a block away at the 5 Point intersection.

The space
What makes our property truly unique and special is its location and proximity to all of the East Nashville and downtown Nashville venues AND the pride we take in providing a neat and clean property for our guests to enjoy.  The master bathroom was completely renovated in January 2024. All of our mattress and bedding were recently updated.  We have our home professionally deep cleaned after each guest visit so the next guest can enjoy themselves in a comfortable and clean environment.

Guest access
Guests have access to everything in our home and on our property.

Other things to note
We prefer a 3 day minimum occupancy for weekends, but we're happy to make exceptions under certain circumstances.  Please ask us!
